{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Democrats believe America can do better.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The immigration system was broken before President Trump came into office.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Immigrants are essential to society and the economy.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Immigrants enrich culture.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Immigrants grow food, care for loved ones, serve in the armed forces, and provide critical health care services.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Immigrants make America stronger.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Families, communities, congregations, schools, and businesses have been built and sustained through the inclusion of immigrants.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats commit to building a 21st century immigration system that reflects values, repairs past harms, heals communities, rebuilds the economy, and renews global leadership.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will right the wrongs of the Trump Administration.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will rescind President Trump's fabricated \"National Emergency\" which siphons funding away from the military to construct a wall on the southern border.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will immediately terminate the Trump Administration's discriminatory travel and immigration bans that disproportionately impact Muslim, Arab, and African people.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[5]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will invite those whose visas have been denied under the Trump Administration's travel and immigration bans to re-apply to come to the United States.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[5]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will support legislation to ensure that no president can enact discriminatory bans ever again.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[5]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
